Audience: first-time North Carolina applicants preparing for the regular Class C knowledge test, in English; the maximum speed table [A02] is core recall material.
Level: a mix of exact numbers (speed limits, stopping distance, following gap) and technique sequences (curves, lane changes) that suit ordered recall drills.
Prerequisites: the school bus material in the previous section, since the bus speed limit reappears in the speed table, and basic vehicle control from the testing section.
Sensitivity: none beyond legal accuracy; speed limits are stated exactly as printed.
